correctness.rationale: For d,r,v>0, D>=0 and arbitrary initial angular law, the Poisson-reset angular generator has unique stationary m_j=r/(r+j²d) and a spectral gap. Centered angular Poisson resolvent Gh_j=h_j/(r+j²d), Gs_j=s_j/(r+j²d) makes the leading tilted-eigenvalue third derivative a finite harmonic computation. Independent sympy cancellation from the h1², s1², h1s1 identities reproduces longitudinal K_xxx=-A and mixed K_xyy=-B exactly, with A,B the positive rational expressions in RESULT.md. Reflection removes the components with odd count of transverse indices, so K3(phi)=-A cos³(phi)-3B cos(phi) sin²(phi). Its absolute value reduces for c=|cos phi| to Ac³+3Bc(1-c²), and its derivative changes optimizer precisely at A=2B. Independently factorized A/B-2=-(14q³+22q²-85q-21)/[(1+q)²(23+7q)], with q=r/d; the cubic has one positive root 1.94554336387280 and the claimed oblique cos²(phi)=B/(3B-A) thereafter. Independent translational Brownian noise has no third cumulant. The proof establishes infinite-time rates; finite Fourier eigenvalue checks are corroborative only.
